scoring_justification: The task requires heavy DFT and Boltzmann transport calculations that cannot be rerun in the lightweight verifier; thus the checker compares the agent's final reported values to the paper's published results with appropriate tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: reference values for all scored fields
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text and figures: kappa_300K=1.82 (text), kappa_900K=0.60 (text), band_gap=~0.75 (abstract and Fig.5), n-type ZT max=1.9 at 4.2e18 cm^-3 (abstract and Fig.6), p-type ZT max=~0.9 at 4.3e20 cm^-3 (Fig.6).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction from the paper's reported numerical values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All values are directly taken from the source paper (doi:10.1088/1361-648X/aba2e7).

outputs.description: JSON file containing the reproduced lattice thermal conductivity at 300 K and 900 K, indirect band gap, maximum n-type and p-type ZT values and their optimal carrier concentrations.

output_contract.notes: All values are compared against a hidden reference (paper-reported results) with appropriate tolerances. The ZT values are directional; the scoring accounts for genuine reproduction accuracy.
